prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: The moon. There was a Samoyed. The Samoyed had an orphan girl. The orphan girl had a bad life. Once the orphan girl went to the river to carry water. She took a kettle and went off. In the river the orphan saw the moon. The orphan says: "Play with me! I like you!", the girl says. Then the orphan is playing with[DCh]: Not clear why causative the moon.
